causes.title: Windows crypto link failures
causes.observed_cause: Bazel MSVC-target links reject libcrypto objects with undefined __stack_chk_fail, ___chkstk_ms, __mingw_fprintf/__mingw_snprintf and other runtime symbols. The Windows Clippy job additionally has third-party expect/unwrap errors.
causes.attribution: The same class of libcrypto unresolved symbols is preserved in the prior Windows release job. An ABI/runtime configuration defect is plausible, but an exact configuration repair is not proven here. Some shards also ran and failed tests; the entire jobs must not be described as compilation-only.

scope_and_limits: Read-only GitHub inspection. No workflow reruns, cancellations, repository writes, dependency changes or CI edits were performed by this audit.
Local files are evidence preservation and derived analysis only. Source snapshots and partial follow-up patch text are not applied to a checkout.
The snapshot covers original head 7ff91 only. Later two-file fixes and local validation require their own exact-source receipts; this snapshot is not their CI result.
Full job logs preserve the exact connector-decoded text via UTF-8 plus lossless gzip; original GitHub log ZIP bytes were not fetched. The ARM artifact ZIP is separately retained byte-for-byte.

Source attribution separates a newly introduced diagnostic, prior observed failures, direct execution-resource errors and unresolved causation. Prior failures do not waive security, build, pressure or integration gates.
Three jobs were still in progress; this is a timestamped snapshot, not the completed workflow verdict.
No complete Chain/Hepta, WAN, confidentiality or whole-chain quantum-resistance qualification follows from these checks.
Readable root excerpts may remove ANSI color escapes for display. The complete gzip logs retain every original escape, byte order and line ending.
